title: Love fills the minds and bodies of the devoted
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 290
summary: The shabad begins with love rising inside the mind and body as a real hunger for darshan and holy company. It asks for one mercy only, the grace to chant Naam, and ends by widening the heart into the Lord's presence everywhere.
whyItMatters: This one speaks to the person who feels unworthy, guarded, or tired of being hard on themselves. Kept close, it makes yearning honest again and shows that mercy often arrives through saintly company and the simple grace to remember.
takeaway: Ask for the grace to remember, and let love soften the guarded heart.

lines.translation: Love and affection, and the taste of yearning, have welled up within;
within my mind and body, this is my purpose:
beholding with my eyes His Blessed Vision, I am at peace.
My mind blossoms forth in ecstasy, washing the feet of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat janaa kai man tan ra(n)g ||
lines.translation: The minds and bodies of His devotees are infused with His Love.
Rare is the one who obtains their company.
Show Your mercy - please, grant me this one request:
by Guru's Grace, may I chant the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa kee upamaa kahee na jai ||

lines.translation: O Nanak, He is contained among all. ||6||

structure: The shabad names love and yearning as the true movement inside the devotee.
From there it praises the company of the holy, where the mind blossoms and devotion deepens.
It finally asks for the one essential gift, Naam, and sees the Lord pervading all.
